metadata.title: Trusted Integration

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating system-to-system integration mechanisms that are secure, semantically stable, and governable at institutional scale.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Event streaming systems, message queues, service buses, schema governance tooling, message security controls, and replay mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite pattern asserting that all trust requirements for application integration and messaging are satisfied.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted integration assumes baseline identity, ownership, boundary control, and accountability.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Trusted integration requires reliable and bounded asynchronous message delivery.

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: depends-on

props.name: attack-tactic

props.name: attack-tactic

props.name: attack-technique

props.name: defense-technique

metadata.remarks: Trusted Integration is a composite pattern asserting that system-to-system integration mechanisms are secure, semantically correct, and governable. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim for solution patterns, risk analysis, and system security and privacy plans.
